8. Typography: sans-serif for the two headers and any body text (#333333); serif italic for all math variables with proper subscripts and superscripts; matrix coefficients tabularly aligned.
9. Final check: the only accent color on the slide is the #FFF9C4 'Use C=1' pill; all other text is #333333 (headers/body) or #000000 (table, equations, constraints); background remains #FFFFFF; no additional decorative elements.
